messages:
maya: Heads-up: we got a DSAR asking for deletion + export for an EU user but it's tied into an active vuln triage. Legal asks we don't irreversibly delete until forensics confirms scope. Can we do a scoped export and then a legal-approved retention exception?
ana-sre: quick q  our CMKs are multi-region replica. If we tombstone the primary key, replicas might still decrypt in other regions unless we remove grants. Need clarity before erase.
jamal: ops can do a one-off export but we should not broaden key access. Proposal: create ephemeral role erasure-temp-4156 with policy limited to kms:Decrypt for specific key ARN + kms:ReEncryptTo on replica arn if needed, and s3:PutObject to s3://privacy-hold/4156/. TTL 48h then auto-revoke.
eli: prefer to avoid ReEncrypt unless absolutely required. Alternative: spin up a short-lived decryption container in eu-west-1 that uses the primary CMK. That keeps crypto ops regional.
tara-privacy: legal needs an auditable manifest: who accessed what, exact keys, files, and an approver signature. If we do retention exception, we need a ticket with CISO sign-off and a start/end time.
ciso: I can sign off if the scope is narrow and we keep artifacts immutable + only allow read/export, not re-ingest. Post the policy + evidence retention plan for review.
security-bot: [INCIDENT] 2026-4209 created: ceres-token-leak. Related to DSAR 2026-ER-88. See #incidents for timeline.
maya: draft policy (please sanity-check):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:ReEncryptFrom"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/pm-*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectTagging"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::privacy-hold/4156/*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"s3:RequestObjectTag/erasure-case":"4156"}}}
  ]
}
```

jamal: add CloudTrail and our audit webhook requirement: put aws:RequestTag/erasure-case=4156 and require aws:PrincipalTag/temporary=true. Also forward events to evidence-bucket with write-once lifecycle.
nana-sre: ops note: if the embeddings index contains the user's text, deleting docs from the vector DB may not remove derived vectors in backups. We'll need a targeted purge + rebuild. That could take hours. Legal: okay with that delay?
tara-privacy: prefer to document acceptable windows. For this case legal prefers: hold for 72h for forensics, then decide retention-exception or delete. Need CISO approval for >48h.
eli: procedure: 1) create ephemeral role in eu-west-1 2) disable cross-region key grants 3) run export to privacy-hold/4156/ 4) snapshot CloudTrail and evidence manifest 5) wait for legal sign-off 6) if approved -> retention exception filed; else trigger irreversible erase job and rotate/tombstone keys.
maya: i'm creating the role now and tagging ticket ER-4156. jamal will run export and paste command.
jamal: running: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456:role/erasure-temp-4156 --duration-seconds 3600` then `aws s3 cp /tmp/export.tar.gz s3://privacy-hold/4156/export-2026-03-22.tar.gz --tagging "erasure-case=4156"`
security-bot: [AUDIT] role erasure-temp-4156 assumed by jamal at 4156789025; actions: kms:Decrypt (3), s3:PutObject (1). Events forwarded to s3://evidence-lockbox/2026/4156/.
tara-privacy: received artifacts, creating legal ticket and requesting CISO sign-off. tagging @ciso. Need exact user list and timestamps in the ticket.
ciso: reviewed logs in evidence-lockbox. Approve retention-exception for 48h to allow forensic correlation. Exception id RE-522. Conditions: no re-ingest into production, quarantine S3 objects, immutable retention.
maya: noted. Setting TTL and configuring lifecycle: quarantine objects set object-lock GOVERNANCE for 48h, then auto-delete unless RE-522 extended.
nana-sre: after RE-522 window, if deletion required we'll: a) key-tombstone primary CMK b) run vector-db purge job with target user id c) expunge S3 objects and rotation proof d) produce final audit manifest.
jamal: export finished. s3://privacy-hold/4156/export-2026-03-22.tar.gz. meta: exporter=jamal, role=erasure-temp-4156, keys=pm-11, duration=00:24:12.
security-bot: [AUDIT] evidence-lock recorded manifest: {case:4156, exporter:jamal, approver:CISO, retention_exception:RE-522}.
tara-privacy: I'll close the DSAR ticket after final disposition and add the audit manifest. If we end up deleting, legal will attach decision rationale.
maya: outstanding action items: jamal revoke role at expiration, nana-sre coordinate purge, eli verify no broad key-policy changes, tara file legal ticket RE-522. Thanks everyone. :lock:
